lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows spanning from the posterior gill margin to the caudal peduncle, with higher density observed in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to shadow-cast lower-intensity pixels on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two white elongated filiform attachments, consistent with parasitic copepods, are visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, slender-bodied commensal fish (remoras) clustered beneath the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
